mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, the temperature is 59 degrees at Harriet Park under a Waxing Gibbous moon, though you should prepare for rain and a low of 47 degrees tonight.

The City of Verona announced that administrative offices will be closed November 26 and 27 for the Thanksgiving holiday, causing a one-day delay for refuse and recycling collection, while the Public Works department is also working on a new facility project to keep up with our growing population.
There is plenty to do this weekend starting with live music today at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's, plus more live music tomorrow at Wisconsin Brewing Company, and look forward to yoga on November 23.
On November 2, officers responded to a domestic disturbance call in the 100 block of West End Circle which resulted in the arrest of a 48-year-old local man for battery and disorderly conduct.
Enjoy the rich taste of today's Crazy for Cookie Dough flavor while the store remains open until 10:30 PM tonight.
